{{Short description|German-born American mechanical engineer (born 1942)}}
'''Wolfgang Sachse''' (born 22 March 1942) is a German-born American mechanical engineer.

Sachse is a native of [[Berlin]].<ref name="achousews">{{cite news |title=Wolfgang Sachse |url=https://alicecookhouse.cornell.edu/people/biographies/wolfgang-sachse |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230204223839/https://alicecookhouse.cornell.edu/people/biographies/wolfgang-sachse |url-status=dead |archive-date=February 4, 2023 |access-date=24 September 2023 |publisher=Alice Cook House, Cornell University}}</ref> He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in physics from [[Pennsylvania State University]], followed by a master's of science in engineering and a doctorate at [[Johns Hopkins University]] in 1970, advised by Robert E. Green.<ref name="whs"/><ref name="achousews"/><ref name="edret">{{cite journal |last1=Every |first1=A. G. |title=Retirement of Wolfgang Sachse as Editor-in-Chief of Ultrasonics |journal=Ultrasonics |date=February 2014 |volume=54 |issue=2 |pages=423–424 |doi=10.1016/j.ultras.2013.10.014 |pmid=24215788}}</ref> He then pursued postdoctoral research as a Humboldt Fellow at [[RWTH Aachen University]].<ref name="achousews"/><ref name="edret"/> Sachse subsequently joined the [[Cornell University]] faculty,<ref name="edret"/> where he was later named Meinig Family Professor of Engineering.<ref name="whs">{{cite news |title=Wolfgang H. Sachse |url=https://www.mae.cornell.edu/faculty-directory/wolfgang-h-sachse-0 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605020419/https://www.mae.cornell.edu/faculty-directory/wolfgang-h-sachse-0 |url-status=dead |archive-date=June 5, 2019 |access-date=24 September 2023 |publisher=Sibley College and School of Mechanical Engineering, Cornell University}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Wolfgang Sachse |url=https://sachse.mae.cornell.edu/ |access-date=24 September 2023 |publisher=Sibley College and School of Mechanical Engineering, Cornell University}}</ref>

Sachse began serving as a member of the international advisory board for the academic journal ''[[Ultrasonics (journal)|Ultrasonics]]'' from the January 1988 issue through at least the February 1998 issue.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Editorial Board |journal=Ultrasonics |date=January 1988 |volume=26 |issue=1 |page=2 |doi=10.1016/0041-624X(88)90041-8}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title=Editorial Board |journal=Ultrasonics |date=February 1998 |volume=36 |issue=1–5 |page=1FC |doi=10.1016/S0041-624X(98)90017-8}}</ref> He succeeded Moshe Rosen as chief editor of the journal in 1999, and stepped down from the position in 2014.<ref name="edret"/>
